initialize_pair_viewer: create a PairViewer instance to visualize 3D reconstruction results for a symmetrized pair of images
get_depthmaps_pair_viewer: retrieve depth maps for both images in the pair by calling get_depthmaps on the PairViewer instance
get_intrinsics_pair_viewer: build camera intrinsics matrices from estimated focals and principal points using get_intrinsics method
get_im_poses_pair_viewer: extract camera pose matrices for both views in the image pair using get_im_poses method
depth_to_pts3d_pair_viewer: convert depth maps to 3D point clouds using depth_to_pts3d with intrinsics and camera poses
